Perform bulk operations on multiple objects at once.

Bulk operations are atomic - either all operations succeed or all fail (transaction-based).
For operations that can partially succeed (like bulk-get), errors are reported per-object.

Available subcommands:
  - create: Create multiple objects from a file
  - update: Update multiple objects from a file
  - get: Get multiple objects by ID
  - delete: Delete multiple objects by ID

  Create multiple objects
  zqk object bulk create backlog_item --file items.yaml
  Update multiple objects
  zqk object bulk update --file updates.yaml
  Get multiple objects
  zqk object bulk get --ids BLI-001,BLI-002,BLI-003

Usage:
  zqk object bulk [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create multiple objects from a file
  delete      Delete multiple objects by ID
  get         Get multiple objects by ID
  update      Bulk update objects (filter or file)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)

Use "zqk object bulk [command] --help" for more information about a command.
